slides.heading: First Mini Program: Simple Receipt
slides.body: First Mini Program: Simple Receipt is part of Introduction to Python and Output. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: First Mini Program: Simple Receipt
slides.body: A mini program can combine several print statements to create a useful output, such as a simple receipt or short report.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A printed receipt has several lines arranged clearly. A program can build the same kind of structured output line by line.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Write one clear instruction at a time. Python reads your code from top to bottom, so order and spelling matter.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Create a three-line receipt with an item, a price, and a thank-you message.
slides.hint: Use one print() call for each receipt line.

quiz.prompt_text: What is the main advantage of using multiple print() statements in a mini program?

options: It lets you build structured, multi-line output like a receipt or report
It automatically saves the output to a file
It allows the program to accept user input

quiz.explanation: Well done! Combining several print() calls lets you build structured output line by line — just like a real receipt or short report.

quiz.prompt_text: Arrange the following lines in the correct order to print a simple receipt showing an item, its price, and a thank-you message.
quiz.explanation: A receipt shows the item first, then the price, and ends with a friendly closing message — the order makes the output logical and easy to read.

quiz.prompt_text: Create a three-line receipt that prints an item name, a price, and a thank-you message.

content.hint: Use one print() call for each receipt line, for example: print("Item: Pen").

quiz.correct_answer: Any valid Python code that satisfies the prompt.
quiz.explanation: Use print("Item: ..."), print("Price: ..."), and print("Thank you!") on three separate lines to build a clean, readable receipt.
